text:
maria_ng: billing-bot just posted an alert — untagged GPU spend spike in us-west-2 (~$45k over last 30d). Can infra confirm any orphaned Dedicated pools or mis-tagged autoscale groups?

billing-bot: [automated] Cost anomaly detected: resource_type=GPU; region=us-west-2; untagged_cost=45000; window=30d; flagged_by=cost-anomaly-v2

jonathan_c: That amount sounds like a few leftover reserved instances + some burst jobs that didn't get the new tagging sidecar. I can run a quick inventory across ASGs and instances.

lee_ops: Please check both Dedicated and Hosted fleets — we've seen tagging drift when we promote images without the new init hook. Also check spot pools that fall back to on-demand.

maria_ng: Agreed. Also we noticed some team-owned notebooks that create ephemeral clusters without the proper cost center tag. Those have been creeping up.

sree_fin: From finance side: we need to attribute this before month close. If tags are missing, we'll either do a retroactive allocation based on usage or charge to Shared Infrastructure until teams submit corrections. Prefer automated retro tagging where possible.

jonathan_c: Quick plan: 1) run SQL to find untagged ENIs / EC2 with GPU profiles in us-west-2 over last 30d; 2) map instance IDs -> IAM principal from CloudTrail; 3) try to match to repo/owner heuristics; 4) if no match, mark as infra-shared.

lee_ops: SQL I used before: ```SELECT resource_id, start_time, end_time, SUM(gpu_hours) as gpu_hours FROM cost_usage WHERE region='us-west-2' AND tags['cost_center'] IS NULL AND resource_type='gpu' AND start_time >= '2026-02-01' GROUP BY resource_id, start_time, end_time;```

maria_ng: Nice. Add `AND tags['project'] IS NULL` to catch both missing fields. Also we should join with cloudtrail: `events where resourceId=resource_id and eventName in ('RunInstances','CreateFleet','CreateNotebookInstance')` to pull the principal.

billing-bot: Recommendation: enable enforced tag policy via org SCP for new Dedicated pools; retroactive suggestion: use billing export to S3 -> run mapping job -> produce "allocation.csv" for finance.

sree_fin: If infra can produce allocation.csv by EOD tomorrow with suggested owners or fallback=infra-shared, finance will apply a temporary chargeback and notify product teams to fix tags. We'll forgive one month after remediation if teams fix tags and submit PR.

jonathan_c: I'll run the inventory now. If we find a large reserved commitment mismatch, we should consider shifting some Reserved Capacity reservations from us-east to us-west POOL to reduce on-demand spend — but that needs sales/commit approval.

lee_ops: Note: reserved capacity is regional and sometimes zonal; moving commitments isn't trivial. We should first exhaust tagging reconciliation and then estimate potential savings from rebalancing. I can draft a short ROI calc.

maria_ng: Also a tactical short-term mitigation: add a firewall rule to block creation of GPU instances without the tag via our admission webhook for private deployments; for hosted flows we can enforce at the control plane.

jonathan_c: Inventory results (prelim): 12 unique instance clusters untagged, ~2200 gpu-hours last 30d, ~ $37k of the flagged $45k. Most are tied to an IAM role that maps to `ml-experiments` repo — looks like a scheduled job that fell back to larger instance types after a config change.

maria_ng: Good catch. Can we patch the schedule to use quota-limited autoscaling and add the tagging sidecar?

jonathan_c: Yes — I'll submit a patch to the infra repo and roll it canary to dev vs prod. Also will produce allocation.csv with suggested owner `ml-platform` for those resources.

sree_fin: Once we have allocation.csv I'll draft the chargeback entries: line items = resource_id, period, gpu_hours, cost, suggested_team, fallback. Finance will apply for Feb invoice and notify teams.

lee_ops: Follow-ups: (1) enforce tag policy for new pools, (2) run daily untagged report into #billing-watch, (3) evaluate 12-month committed use discount for steady baseline after we clean labels.

maria_ng: Thanks team. Jonathan — ping here when allocation.csv is in S3 (s3://redwood-billing/allocations/1763600000-allocation.csv) and I'll approve the temporary chargeback. :thumbsup:
